slug: 2026-02-06 Chad Moves to Secure National Data Center Ahead of Launch

facts.fact: The National Agency for Information Security and Electronic Certification (ANSICE) is stated to operate: on 5 February 2026 it signed a tripartite agreement with ADETIC and Techso Group for a security audit and certification of the national data center, with its deputy director general quoted.
